correctness.rationale: Count lower-symbol multiplicity j in a four-term window. For u>0, j=0,1,4 contradict largest=sum of two smallest; j=2,3 work iff v=2u. For u=0, only 4 zeros or one zero can appear; sliding cannot transition between these counts without forbidden intermediate 2 or 3 zeros, hence only zero constant or one zero in every window, giving e_(i+4)=e_i and exactly four phases. Build 8-state suffix transfer matrix for binary 4-blocks with 2 or 3 ones. Independent exact symbolic inversion of I-zM gives GF (1+z+2z²+3z³−z⁴−2z⁶−2z⁷+z⁹)/(1−z−z³−z⁴+z⁶); characteristic x(x+1)(x^6−x^5−x^3−x²+1). Essential 7-state graph strongly connected and primitive by 3- and 4-cycles; Perron spectral radius >1 yields entropy and uncountably many aperiodic paths. Independent exact counts n=0..13 agree [1,2,4,8,10,16,25,39,61,95,149,233,364,569].
